//: Copilot CLI counterpart of the PostToolUse(Write|Edit) check in .claude/settings.json:
warn when a freshly edited .java file carries fully-qualified class names.
Copilot has no matcher on repo hooks, so the script self-filters: it exits 0
unless the payload carries a path ending in .java. --copilot only switches the
output envelope (top-level additionalContext instead of hookSpecificOutput).
